<h2>Build Programmatic Trait Review Triage</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Proposes no action only after completed investigation, retains unresolved
evidence for programmatic review, and groups reproducible correction
hypotheses for cost-gated agent investigation.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_trait_review_programmatic_triage(
  data_candidate_recommendations,
  data_approved_decisions,
  data_proposal_diagnostics,
  data_dataset_evidence,
  data_record_evidence,
  data_agent_adjudications,
  evidence_reference,
  min_source_pattern_candidates = 3L,
  source_factor_relative_tolerance = 0.25,
  agent_groups_per_batch = 10L
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate_recommendations">data_candidate_recommendations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate recommendations from [diagnose_trait_review_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_approved_decisions">data_approved_decisions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Current canonical decisions from [load_trait_review_decisions()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_proposal_diagnostics">data_proposal_diagnostics</code></td>
<td>
<p>Recovered selector diagnostics from
[diagnose_trait_review_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_dataset_evidence">data_dataset_evidence</code></td>
<td>
<p>Dataset summaries from [build_trait_review_evidence_packets()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_record_evidence">data_record_evidence</code></td>
<td>
<p>Record evidence from [build_trait_review_evidence_packets()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_agent_adjudications">data_agent_adjudications</code></td>
<td>
<p>Completed adjudications. May be a zero-row data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="evidence_reference">evidence_reference</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty path to the human-readable triage report.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="min_source_pattern_candidates">min_source_pattern_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Minimum candidates sharing a source/factor pattern before escalation.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="source_factor_relative_tolerance">source_factor_relative_tolerance</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum relative error from factors 10, 100, or 1000.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="agent_groups_per_batch">agent_groups_per_batch</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum exception groups assigned to one initial agent batch.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list containing candidate triage, completed-investigation no-action
proposals, pending programmatic cases, exception memberships and groups, a
cost-gated agent queue, and summary.
</p>

</main>
